item: row 361 group 1: the keyword fold's refusal line follows a language switch, and the clean-up's error line shows the error as sent
summary: foldKeywords drew a refusal (lemmatisation off, no lemmatiser) straight into #kw-fold-status, past the reading the job-line repaint keeps, so the line froze in the language it was drawn in. Every write of a reading into a job line now goes through _drawJobLine, which keeps the reading for repaintDiagnosticsJobsFromCache; a node test drives the refusal through a switch and fails on the old write. cleanupKeywords wrote esc(e.message) into the line with textContent, so an ampersand showed as &; _jobLineError writes the error as sent (data, not chrome: nothing is translated or kept). Both leave configs/i18n_frozen_renderers.txt. No new strings.
